name: Aristolochia
shared_genus_traits: Alternate simple leaves; petaloid tubular fused calyx, no separate corolla; inferior ovary; many-seeded capsule.
look_here_first: Inspect a flower low on the stem, then the full leaf and perianth tip.
overlap_and_cautions: Both have low tubular flowers; leaf size and habitat alone can mislead.
local_lookalikes: Aristolochia reticulata needs separate diagnostic review.
Sterile grasslike herbs may resemble A. erecta.

handoffs.task: Obtain matched perianth and fruit macros; reuse existing media.
